modules.name: Production engine and scan coordinator
modules.description: Owns the JSONL API, safety gates, authoritative device state, and projection transaction ordering.
modules.execution: Receives versioned requests from Tauri, invokes device modules, and emits complete snapshots.

modules.name: Moxtek X-ray source
modules.description: Owns Moxtek discovery, binary serial transport, measured readback, and fail-closed beam shutdown.
modules.execution: The scan coordinator requests setpoints and beam transitions; this module verifies source responses.

modules.name: Nikon D7100 camera
modules.description: Owns camera discovery, exposure configuration, host-side capture, and image-file confirmation.
modules.execution: The engine calls DigiCamControl and accepts a projection only after the expected host file is confirmed.

modules.name: RTS9060 Nano turntable
modules.description: Owns Nano identity validation, line protocol, motion acknowledgement, warning output, and emergency stop.
modules.execution: A serial worker executes one versioned command stream while the engine waits for confirmed motion states.

modules.name: Tauri desktop shell
modules.description: Owns native dialogs and paths, sidecar lifecycle, and IPC forwarding without owning scan state.
modules.execution: Tauri receives frontend commands, exchanges versioned JSONL with ct-engine, and returns engine snapshots.

modules.name: Frontend engine contract
modules.description: Defines the TypeScript command and snapshot vocabulary shared by production and preview clients.
modules.execution: React reads complete snapshots and submits domain commands through EngineAdapter.

modules.name: Frontend engine client
modules.description: Selects the runtime adapter and exposes engine snapshots to React without fallback after Tauri errors.
modules.execution: The browser selects preview only outside Tauri; production commands use Tauri invoke exclusively.

modules.name: Browser-only workstation preview
modules.description: Simulates device and scan behavior for browser development; it never accesses physical hardware.
modules.execution: An in-memory firmware transport drives a preview workflow that emits the production view-model shape.

modules.name: React workstation shell
modules.description: Owns panels, menus, safety presentation, layout, themes, and static UI assets.
modules.execution: Renders only from engine snapshots and converts user gestures into EngineCommand values.

modules.name: Read-only 3D equipment scene
modules.description: Owns visualization geometry, theme conversion, camera navigation, and WebGL fallback.
modules.execution: Consumes a read-only scene view-model and never sends hardware commands.

modules.name: Frontend platform integration
modules.description: Provides desktop-only paths, dialogs, directory reveal, and log export behind small functions.
modules.execution: Calls Tauri only after confirming the desktop runtime; browser preview uses safe defaults.

modules.name: Build and verification tooling
modules.description: Owns dependency locks, build entry points, contract tests, module-map generation, and impact analysis.
modules.execution: Selects and runs deterministic local gates; it must not contact real hardware.

modules.name: Optional algorithms and service bridges
modules.description: Holds optional algorithm contracts and the Sites-compatible static worker, outside the safety control loop.
modules.execution: Extensions consume exported data or serve built assets; they cannot command production devices.

modules.name: Architecture, guides, and evidence
modules.description: Explains current architecture, operating constraints, historical plans, and verification evidence.
modules.execution: Current architecture documents follow source and tests; historical files must identify themselves as historical.

modules.name: Generated release artifacts
modules.description: Contains replaceable packaged binaries and is never a source of design truth.
modules.execution: Release tooling regenerates these files from verified source builds.
